verdict.rationale: Plaid's own GitHub organization hosts plaid-node, an official Node client library, with code showing typed API calls (plaidClient.transactionsSync) and documented async/await error handling, so the product does ship an official SDK. The evidence only shows a single language, and no first-party docs describe the SDK lineup, versioning or install paths. The OpenAPI probe also found no public spec for generating other clients. Missing for 10: first-party docs listing official SDKs across languages, evidence of SDKs beyond Node, SDK reference/installation documentation, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: All errors can now be caught using try/catch with async/await or through promise chaining.
